titleEn: US: Connecting Northwest Arkansas with fresh, locally grown produce through vertical farming
titleZh: 美国阿肯色州垂直农场用气雾塔为学校供应新鲜蔬菜
summaryZh: 美国阿肯色州西北部的一个温室项目采用垂直气雾栽培塔，在有限空间内高效生产清洁、本地化的蔬菜，每周向当地学区供应数百磅生菜，学生食用量增加且浪费减少。该案例展示了垂直农业在果蔬种植中的节水、节地优势，对智慧畜牧行业在饲料作物或温室种植方面有一定借鉴意义。
featuredReason: 垂直农业技术虽非直接用于畜牧，但其高效利用空间和水资源的模式可启发智慧畜牧行业在饲料作物或温室种植环节的创新应用。
contentFull:
BENTONVILLE, Ark. (RFD News) — A Northwest Arkansas greenhouse is using vertical aeroponic towers to provide fresh produce to local schools and families year-round.

Manager Grant Wilson said the Fresh Greens Project was developed to grow clean, locally produced food while maximizing space and reducing water use through its vertical growing system.

The greenhouse now supplies hundreds of pounds of lettuce to local school districts each week, where Wilson said students are eating more fresh lettuce with less going to waste.
